ann.t: We hereby submit the Newspaper Publication in relation to Advertisement publish for Meetings of Equity Shareholders and Unsecured Creditors called pursuant to order of Hon''ble NCLT, Ahmedabad

We hereby submit the Notice calling the General Meeting of Unsecured Creditors of the Company called pursuant to Order Dated October 31, 2026 issued by Hon''ble NCLT, Ahmedabad bench in the matter of Composite Scheme of Amalgamation of Shish Polylam Private Limited and Shish Global Solutions Private

In terms of the Hon''ble NCLT, Ahmedabad Bench Order dated October 31, 2026, the Meeting of the Equity Shareholders of the Company is scheduled to be held on Tuesday, December 15, 2026 at 10.30 AM IST through VC / OAVM. 
We attach herewith the copy of Notice calling meeting of shareholders.
